response.message: Astra: How does Rohin’s pilot example, “no execution receipt is visible,” help distinguish your written feedback from evidence that it works? In your draft, what supports the claim that checking an example will “ensure” reliability? Would thinking more about that claim settle a specific uncertainty, or would a small attempt on the draft yield better evidence? Which thinking or doing step do you choose to carry out on this draft now? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding, visible source, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
response.rationale: Focuses attention on one claim in the existing draft, distinguishing written work from validation while leaving the next action to the learner.
